subject.title: [Feature/Bug]: Isolate subagent completion from parent context; return status + child session link only by default

question: Should native subagent completion change from automatic child-result transfer to a metadata-only default with explicit bounded result retrieval, and what compatibility path should existing parent workflows receive?
rationale: The requested behavior changes the supervisor/worker interaction contract rather than repairing only the separately tracked usage-accounting defect; source-level evidence is also unavailable in this read-only environment to safely select a compatibility implementation unilaterally.

options.title: Adopt metadata-only completion
options.body: Define a bounded status-and-session-handle event as the default and provide an explicit bounded child-result reader with a documented migration path.

options.title: Retain final-result transfer
options.body: Keep automatic final-result delivery and limit work to accounting and payload-size safeguards without changing the parent-facing contract.

options.title: Offer an explicit transition mode
options.body: Introduce a temporary, documented compatibility mode only if maintainers confirm a shipped parent-workflow contract requires it.

recommendation.title: Adopt metadata-only completion
recommendation.body: Define a bounded status-and-session-handle event as the default and provide an explicit bounded child-result reader with a documented migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate in the supplied evidence because they can validate the observed workflow and clarify the expected supervisor behavior; a runtime owner should make the final product decision.
